title: Delhi Metro Fare Calculator: How Fares Are Calculated by Distance in 2026
description: Get the complete 2026 Delhi Metro fare calculator guide. Learn how fares are calculated by distance with updated slab rates (₹11–₹64), Smart Card discounts, Sunday holiday rates, and travel time limits.
body:
If you commute via the [Delhi Metro](https://metroguideindia.com/delhi-metro/) or plan to use it soon, understanding how the Delhi Metro fare is calculated is essential for budgeting your daily travel. As of 2026, Delhi Metro uses a distance-based slab system that charges passengers according to how many kilometres they travel. The fare structure was revised in August 2025 after an 8-year gap, marking the first fare hike since 2017.

This comprehensive guide covers everything you need to know about Delhi Metro fares in 2026, from the exact fare slabs and Smart Card discounts to Sunday holiday rates, travel time limits, and tips to save money on your commutes.

***

## How Delhi Metro Fare Is Calculated in 2026

Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) calculates fares based on the distance between your origin and destination stations. The system uses distance slabs, meaning you pay a fixed rate for falling within a specific distance range, not per kilometre.

### Key Facts About the Fare System

| Aspect | Details |
| **Pricing Model** | Distance-based slab system |
| **Minimum Fare** | ₹11 (for 0–2 km) |
| **Maximum Fare** | ₹64 (for journeys beyond 32 km) |
| **Fare Revision** | August 25, 2025 (first hike since 2017) |
| **Increase Range** | ₹1 to ₹5 across various slabs |
| **Travel Time Limit** | 65–240 minutes depending on distance |

The fare structure applies uniformly across all Delhi Metro lines, including the Yellow Line, Blue Line, Red Line, Green Line, Grey Line, Magenta Line, Orange Line (Airport Express), Violet Line, and Pink Line.

***

## Complete Delhi Metro Fare Slabs 2026 (Monday–Saturday)

Here's the official **weekday fare structure** effective from August 25, 2025:

### Weekday Fare Table (Monday to Saturday)

| Distance (km) | Token Fare (Cash) | Smart Card Fare (10% off) | Maximum Travel Time |
| **0 – 2 km** | ₹11 | ₹10 | 65 minutes |
| **2 – 5 km** | ₹21 | ₹19 | 65 minutes |
| **5 – 12 km** | ₹32 | ₹29 | 90 minutes |
| **12 – 21 km** | ₹43 | ₹39 | 100 minutes |
| **21 – 32 km** | ₹54 | ₹49 | 180 minutes |
| **More than 32 km** | ₹64 | ₹58 | 240 minutes |

**Important Notes:**

- **Token Fare** = Single-journey ticket purchased at the station
- **Smart Card Fare** = 10% discount automatically applied when using the Delhi Metro Smart Card
- **Travel Time** = Maximum time allowed inside the metro system from entry to exit

***

## Sunday & National Holiday Discounted Fare Slabs 2026

One of the best-kept secrets about Delhi Metro is the **discounted fare on Sundays and national holidays**. These rates can save you significant money on weekend travel.

### Sunday & Holiday Fare Table (Discounted Rates)

| Distance (km) | Token Fare | Smart Card Fare (10% off) | Savings vs Weekday |
| **0 – 2 km** | ₹11 | ₹10 | Same as weekday |
| **2 – 5 km** | ₹11 | ₹10 | **Save ₹10** |
| **5 – 12 km** | ₹21 | ₹19 | **Save ₹11** |
| **12 – 21 km** | ₹32 | ₹29 | **Save ₹11** |
| **21 – 32 km** | ₹43 | ₹39 | **Save ₹11** |
| **More than 32 km** | ₹54 | ₹49 | **Save ₹10** |

**Key Benefits of Sunday Travel:**

- Maximum savings of **₹11 per journey** on longer distances
- Same [Smart Card](https://metroguideindia.com/blog/delhi-metro-smart-card-vs-qr-ticket.html) discount (10%) applies on top of holiday fares
- Ideal for weekend shopping, outings, or visiting family

***

## Delhi Metro Fare History: How We Got to 2026 Rates

Understanding the fare evolution helps explain why the 2025 revision was significant after such a long gap.

### Major Fare Changes Over the Years

| Year | Fare Structure | Key Changes |
| **2017** | 0–2 km: ₹10\n2–5 km: ₹20\n5–12 km: ₹30\n12–21 km: ₹40\n21–32 km: ₹50\n>32 km: ₹60 | Fourth Fare Fixation Committee recommendation |
| **2025 (Aug)** | 0–2 km: ₹11\n2–5 km: ₹21\n5–12 km: ₹32\n12–21 km: ₹43\n21–32 km: ₹54\n>32 km: ₹64 | First hike in 8 years; ₹1–₹5 increase |
| **2026 (Current)** | Same as 2025 revision | No further changes; current rates in effect |

The 2025 fare hike was described by DMRC as **"minimal"** — ranging only from ₹1 to ₹4 depending on distance — after an 8-year gap without any increase.

***

## How to Calculate Your Delhi Metro Fare Step-by-Step

Follow these simple steps to estimate your fare before travelling:

### Step 1: Find Your Distance

Use the **official Delhi Metro Fare Calculator** or Google Maps to find the distance between your origin and destination stations.

### Step 2: Match to the Correct Slab

Compare your distance to the fare slabs in the tables above:

- **0–2 km** → ₹11 (weekday) / ₹11 (Sunday)
- **2–5 km** → ₹21 (weekday) / ₹11 (Sunday)
- **5–12 km** → ₹32 (weekday) / ₹21 (Sunday)
- **12–21 km** → ₹43 (weekday) / ₹32 (Sunday)
- **21–32 km** → ₹54 (weekday) / ₹43 (Sunday)
- **>32 km** → ₹64 (weekday) / ₹54 (Sunday)

### Step 3: Apply Smart Card Discount (If Applicable)

If you use a **Smart Card**, subtract 10% from the token fare:

Smart Card Fare=Token Fare×0.90Smart Card Fare=Token Fare×0.90

For example:

- ₹21 token fare → ₹19 Smart Card fare (rounded)
- ₹64 token fare → ₹58 Smart Card fare (rounded)

### Step 4: Check if It's Sunday or Holiday

If travelling on **Sunday or a national holiday**, use the discounted Sunday fare table instead.

***

## Delhi Metro Smart Card: How to Save 10% on Every Journey

The **Delhi Metro Smart Card** is the most cost-effective way to commute, offering an automatic **10% discount** on all journeys.

### Smart Card Benefits

| Benefit | Details |
| **Discount** | 10% off all fare slabs |
| **Validity** | 1 year from date of purchase |
| **Initial Cost** | ₹150 (includes ₹50 refundable security) |
| **Recharge Range** | ₹200 to ₹3000 (non-refundable, usable only for metro rides) |
| **Convenience** | Tap-and-go entry; no queuing for tickets |

### How to Get a Smart Card

1. Visit any Delhi Metro station ticket counter
2. Pay ₹150 initial cost (₹50 refundable security + ₹100 initial load)
3. Provide basic ID proof
4. Recharge at any station or via the **DMRC app**

### When Smart Card Pays Off

If you commute **daily** (2 trips × 5 days = 10 trips/week), the Smart Card saves you approximately:

- **₹100–₹200 per week** on medium-distance commutes
- **₹400–₹800 per month**
- **₹4,800–₹9,600 per year**

The ₹150 card cost pays for itself within **2–3 weeks** of regular use.

***

## Maximum Travel Time Limits in Delhi Metro 2026

Delhi Metro enforces **maximum travel time limits** based on distance. If you exceed this time, you may need to pay an additional fare at the exit station.

### Travel Time Limits by Distance

| Distance (km) | Maximum Travel Time |
| 0 – 5 km | 65 minutes |
| 5 – 12 km | 90 minutes |
| 12 – 21 km | 100 minutes |
| 21 – 32 km | 180 minutes (3 hours) |
| More than 32 km | 240 minutes (4 hours) |

**Why This Matters:**

- Time starts from **entry tap** to **exit tap**
- Includes time spent on trains, platform waiting, and transfers
- Useful for long commutes with transfers or unexpected delays
- Exceeding limits may result in **additional fare charges**

***

## Tips to Save Money on Delhi Metro Commutes

### 1. Use a Smart Card Always

Get the automatic **10% discount** on every journey.

### 2. Travel on Sundays When Possible

Save **₹10–₹11** per journey on discounted Sunday fares.

### 3. Plan Your Route to Minimize Distance

Shorter distances = lower fare slabs. Sometimes a slightly longer walking distance to a closer station saves money.

### 4. Avoid Peak Hours If Flexible

While fare is the same, peak hours (9–11 AM, 6–8 PM) are more crowded. Off-peak travel is more comfortable.

### 5. Recharge Smart Card in Bulk

Recharge ₹500–₹1000 at once to avoid frequent counter visits and ensure you never get stuck without balance.

### 6. Use Monthly Passes for Regular Commuters

If you commute daily, check if a **monthly pass** offers better value than per-journey fares (available for specific routes).

***

## Conclusion

Understanding **how Delhi Metro fare is calculated in 2026** helps you plan your commutes better and save money. The distance-based slab system charges **₹11 to ₹64** depending on your travel distance, with **Smart Card users getting 10% off** and **Sunday travellers enjoying discounted fares** of up to ₹11 per journey.

The **August 2025 fare revision** was the first hike in 8 years, with minimal increases of ₹1–₹5 across slabs. By using a Smart Card, travelling on Sundays when possible, and planning your routes efficiently, you can maximize savings on Delhi Metro commutes.

**Key Takeaways:**

- Minimum fare: **₹11** (0–2 km)
- Maximum fare: **₹64** (>32 km)
- Smart Card discount: **10%** on all journeys
- Sunday discount: **₹10–₹11** savings per trip
- Travel time limits: **65–240 minutes** based on distance

For the most accurate fare calculation, always use the official DMRC fare calculator before your journey.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) About Delhi Metro Fare

### 1. What is the minimum Delhi Metro fare in 2026?

The minimum fare is **₹11** for journeys up to 2 km.

### 2. What is the maximum Delhi Metro fare in 2026?

The maximum fare is **₹64** for journeys beyond 32 km.

### 3. Is Delhi Metro fare the same on all days?

No. **Sundays and national holidays** have discounted fares that can save you ₹10–₹11 per journey.

### 4. How much discount do I get with a Smart Card?

Smart Card users get a **10% discount** on all fare slabs.

### 5. When was the last Delhi Metro fare hike?

The last fare hike was on **August 25, 2025**, after an 8-year gap since 2017.

### 6. How is Delhi Metro fare calculated?

Fares are calculated using a **distance-based slab system** where you pay a fixed rate for your distance range, not per kilometre.

### 7. Can I use the same ticket for multiple journeys?

No. **Token tickets** are single-journey only. For multiple journeys, use a **Smart Card**.

### 8. What happens if I exceed the maximum travel time?

If you exceed the time limit for your distance slab, you may need to **pay additional fare** at the exit station.

### 9. Are there any free travels on Delhi Metro?

Children below **5 years** travel free. No other free travel concessions are available for general passengers.

### 10. How do I find the distance between two metro stations?

Use the **official Delhi Metro website fare calculator**, Google Maps, or apps like **Delhi Metro Rail Info** to find station distances.
